newsitem.title: USA: Man forces Kentucky woman into a shopping spree.
newsitem.headline: Man forces Kentucky woman into a shopping spree.

text.p: A man allegedly abducted a 51-year-old woman at gunpoint and ordered her to charge thousands of dollars worth of electronic equipment and other goods on her credit cards, police said on Monday.
But Frederick Harris, 41, was caught on Sunday after a store manager alerted police when the woman tried to charge $800 worth of cigarettes, the police said.

"That's a lot of cigarettes and the manager became suspicious and called police," Louisville Police Officer Aaron Graham said. They found electronic equipment and other items bought from stores in Kentucky and Indiana in the back of the woman's car.
Harris was being held on kidnapping charge and on roughly 20 previous arrest warrants for robbery and other alleged crimes.
